day5_afternoon_start.name: Me
day5_afternoon_start.text: *Before I knew it, afternoon. The sky above the rooftop is starting to turn orange.*

day5_true_love_start.name: Me
day5_true_love_start.text: *Standing side by side under the sunset with my partner. I wish this moment would freeze.*

day5_true_talk_1.name: Me
day5_true_talk_1.text: "You know... before I transferred, the new school honestly scared me."

day5_true_talk_2.name: Me
day5_true_talk_2.text: "But now I think transferring here was the best thing I've ever done."

day5_true_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_true_seoyeon.text: "...Me too. I'm glad you came. Stay by my side... from now on."

day5_true_yuna.name: Yuna
day5_true_yuna.text: "...I thought being alone was easier. But when you showed up... I realized it wasn't."

day5_true_dain.name: Dain
day5_true_dain.text: "Every day got way more fun since you came! You'll keep cheering me on, right?!"

day5_true_nurse.name: Nurse
day5_true_nurse.text: "I know this won't be easy. But if it's you, it's okay. Together, we can handle anything."

day5_true_teacher.name: Teacher
day5_true_teacher.text: "...A teacher shouldn't be doing this. But what can I do— it's real. Let's make this work, you and me."

day5_true_kiss_buildup.name: Me
day5_true_kiss_buildup.text: *The wind blows. Their face, bathed in sunset, feels unusually close.*

day5_true_kiss_2.name: Me
day5_true_kiss_2.text: *We look into each other's eyes. No words needed.*

day5_true_kiss_5.name: Me
day5_true_kiss_5.text: *A soft warmth. Time seemed to stop.*

day5_true_kiss_after.name: Me
day5_true_kiss_after.text: *I opened my eyes. They were smiling in the sunset light. The most beautiful face in the world.*

day5_bed_seoyeon_1.name: Me
day5_bed_seoyeon_1.text: *The sun had set. I was going to walk her home, but Seoyeon grabbed my sleeve.*

day5_bed_seoyeon_2.name: Seoyeon
day5_bed_seoyeon_2.text: "...Um. My parents aren't home today. Just for a bit... do you want to come in?"

day5_bed_seoyeon_3.name: Me
day5_bed_seoyeon_3.text: *A quiet residential street. Through the front door, past the spacious living room, up to Seoyeon's room on the second floor.*

day5_bed_seoyeon_4.name: Me
day5_bed_seoyeon_4.text: *A neatly organized space. A bookshelf packed with books, student council documents, soft ambient lighting. The room was filled with Seoyeon's scent.*

day5_bed_seoyeon_4b.name: Seoyeon
day5_bed_seoyeon_4b.text: "...My parents' room is on the first floor, so it's fine. Oh, that's not what I— just, come sit here."

day5_bed_seoyeon_5.name: Me
day5_bed_seoyeon_5.text: *We sat side by side on the edge of the bed. Seoyeon's hands were trembling slightly.*

day5_bed_seoyeon_6.name: Seoyeon
day5_bed_seoyeon_6.text: "...I always had to be perfect. Because I'm the student council president. But with you... I just want to be me."

day5_bed_seoyeon_7.name: Me
day5_bed_seoyeon_7.text: *Seoyeon rested her head on my shoulder. My heart felt like it would burst.*

day5_bed_yuna_1.name: Me
day5_bed_yuna_1.text: *The sun had set. I was about to head back, but Yuna grabbed my hand.*

day5_bed_yuna_2.name: Yuna
day5_bed_yuna_2.text: "...Not yet. There's a place I want to show you."

day5_bed_yuna_3.name: Me
day5_bed_yuna_3.text: *Yuna led me to the top of the library annex— a hidden attic nobody knows about.*

day5_bed_yuna_4.name: Me
day5_bed_yuna_4.text: *An old sofa, a single blanket, stars visible through a small window. Yuna's secret space.*

day5_bed_yuna_5.name: Yuna
day5_bed_yuna_5.text: "...I was the only one who knew about this place. Now you do too."

day5_bed_yuna_6.name: Me
day5_bed_yuna_6.text: *Yuna spread out the blanket. Sitting side by side on the narrow sofa, our shoulders touched.*

day5_bed_dain_1.name: Me
day5_bed_dain_1.text: *The sun had set. Dain dangled the gym key with a grin.*

day5_bed_dain_2.name: Dain
day5_bed_dain_2.text: "...Here— my secret spot. Wanna look at stars together?"

day5_bed_dain_3.name: Me
day5_bed_dain_3.text: *The gym at night, completely empty. Dain laid out mats and opened the skylight in the ceiling.*

day5_bed_dain_4.name: Me
day5_bed_dain_4.text: *We lay side by side on the mats, looking up at the stars. I could hear Dain breathing close by.*

day5_bed_dain_5.name: Dain
day5_bed_dain_5.text: "...Hey, my heart is racing so fast right now. Put your hand here and feel it."

day5_bed_dain_6.name: Me
day5_bed_dain_6.text: *Dain took my hand and placed it over her chest. It really was beating fast.*

day5_bed_dain_7.name: Dain
day5_bed_dain_7.text: "...Dummy, why are you staring like that. It's embarrassing..."

day5_bed_nurse_1.name: Me
day5_bed_nurse_1.text: *The sun had set. The nurse smiled meaningfully.*

day5_bed_nurse_2.name: Nurse
day5_bed_nurse_2.text: "...There shouldn't be anyone left at school. Want to stop by the nurse's office?"

day5_bed_nurse_3.name: Me
day5_bed_nurse_3.text: *Click. The sound of the nurse's office door locking.*

day5_bed_nurse_4.name: Me
day5_bed_nurse_4.text: *The curtained bed area. Instead of disinfectant, a faint scent of perfume.*

day5_bed_nurse_5.name: Nurse
day5_bed_nurse_5.text: "In here, I'm not 'the nurse.' Just a woman."

day5_bed_nurse_6.name: Me
day5_bed_nurse_6.text: *We sat side by side on the edge of the bed. Her hand rested on top of mine.*

day5_bed_nurse_7.name: Nurse
day5_bed_nurse_7.text: "...Just for tonight— no student, no teacher. Just... us."

day5_bed_teacher_1.name: Me
day5_bed_teacher_1.text: *The sun had set. Teacher pulled out her car keys and jingled them.*

day5_bed_teacher_2.name: Teacher
day5_bed_teacher_2.text: "...I'll give you a ride. It's late."

day5_bed_teacher_3.name: Me
day5_bed_teacher_3.text: *The car didn't stop at my house. It stopped in front of her apartment.*

day5_bed_teacher_4.name: Teacher
day5_bed_teacher_4.text: "...Just one cup of coffee. I'll send you home after. Probably."

day5_bed_teacher_5.name: Me
day5_bed_teacher_5.text: *A small but tidy apartment. Ungraded exams piled on the desk. We sat side by side on the sofa.*

day5_bed_teacher_6.name: Teacher
day5_bed_teacher_6.text: "...Hah, I really have no business being a teacher. Bringing a student home..."

day5_bed_teacher_7.name: Me
day5_bed_teacher_7.text: *She pulled her hair tie out and smiled weakly. The coffee went cold in the end.*

day5_true_morning_seoyeon_1.name: Me
day5_true_morning_seoyeon_1.text: *A night where our warmth intertwined and the distance between us silently vanished— it had passed.*

day5_true_morning_seoyeon_2.name: Me
day5_true_morning_seoyeon_2.text: *I opened my eyes. In the morning light seeping through the curtains, Seoyeon was watching me quietly.*

day5_true_morning_seoyeon_3.name: Seoyeon
day5_true_morning_seoyeon_3.text: "...You're up early. You can sleep a little more."

day5_true_morning_seoyeon_4.name: Me
day5_true_morning_seoyeon_4.text: *Our eyes met and a faint blush crept across Seoyeon's cheeks. Not the flawless student council president— just Seoyeon, mine alone.*

day5_true_morning_seoyeon_5.name: Me
day5_true_morning_seoyeon_5.text: *The warmth passing between our clasped hands. An ordinary moment becoming something miraculous.*

day5_true_morning_yuna_1.name: Me
day5_true_morning_yuna_1.text: *On the narrow attic sofa, a night where only our quiet breathing mingled— it had passed.*

day5_true_morning_yuna_2.name: Me
day5_true_morning_yuna_2.text: *I tried to open my eyes, but a small warmth was clinging tightly to my arm.*

day5_true_morning_yuna_3.name: Yuna
day5_true_morning_yuna_3.text: "...Where do you think you're going. Stay next to me all day today."

day5_true_morning_yuna_4.name: Me
day5_true_morning_yuna_4.text: *Yuna murmured in her half-sleep and burrowed deeper into my arms. The girl who was always so guarded, showing me her completely defenseless side.*

day5_true_morning_yuna_5.name: Me
day5_true_morning_yuna_5.text: *In this quiet, perfect world, I decided to become her sanctuary.*

day5_true_morning_dain_1.name: Me
day5_true_morning_dain_1.text: *On the gym mats under a cascade of starlight, a night where our heartbeats merged into one— it had passed.*

day5_true_morning_dain_2.name: Me
day5_true_morning_dain_2.text: *I opened my eyes to the morning light. Dain was sprawled across me, one leg slung over my stomach, fast asleep.*

day5_true_morning_dain_3.name: Dain
day5_true_morning_dain_3.text: "...Mmm, good morning. Seeing you the second I open my eyes feels really... weird."

day5_true_morning_dain_4.name: Me
day5_true_morning_dain_4.text: *Dain rubbed her eyes and grinned that radiant grin. Last night's shyness was nowhere to be found— just her usual bright energy.*

day5_true_morning_dain_5.name: Me
day5_true_morning_dain_5.text: *If I get to see this dazzling smile every morning, there won't be a dull moment for the rest of my days.*

day5_true_morning_nurse_1.name: Me
day5_true_morning_nurse_1.text: *A night drawn in by the scent of perfume and an adult's easy confidence— it had passed.*

day5_true_morning_nurse_2.name: Me
day5_true_morning_nurse_2.text: *I opened my eyes. She was resting her chin on her hand, gazing down at my face. Our eyes met.*

day5_true_morning_nurse_3.name: Nurse
day5_true_morning_nurse_3.text: "Sleep well? You're pretty cute when you're asleep, too."

day5_true_morning_nurse_4.name: Me
day5_true_morning_nurse_4.text: *Her fingertips traced softly down my cheek. Behind the playful smile, I could feel something deep.*

day5_true_morning_nurse_5.name: Me
day5_true_morning_nurse_5.text: *No longer teacher and student— our first morning as two people, whole and equal.*

day5_true_morning_teacher_1.name: Me
day5_true_morning_teacher_1.text: *A night that was clumsy and awkward, but all the more genuine for it— it had passed.*

day5_true_morning_teacher_2.name: Me
day5_true_morning_teacher_2.text: *A rustling sound woke me. She was tiptoeing, trying to sneak out of bed.*

day5_true_morning_teacher_3.name: Teacher
day5_true_morning_teacher_3.text: "...You're awake? I was going to sneak off and make coffee. Busted."

day5_true_morning_teacher_4.name: Me
day5_true_morning_teacher_4.text: *Her face was bright red, completely flustered. I caught her hand and pulled her back into my arms.*

day5_true_morning_teacher_5.name: Me
day5_true_morning_teacher_5.text: ("Just five more minutes like this." The strict mask had fallen away. I wanted to protect this person for the rest of my life.)

day5_good_start.name: Me
day5_good_start.text: *Standing side by side under the sunset with my partner. Things got complicated along the way, but in the end, I'm here with this person.*

day5_good_talk_1.name: Me
day5_good_talk_1.text: "...I'll be honest. At first, my heart wavered. There were so many great people."

day5_good_talk_2.name: Me
day5_good_talk_2.text: "But in the end, the only one my heart kept going to was you."

day5_good_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_good_seoyeon.text: "...I knew. That you were nice to the other girls too. But you're by my side in the end. That's all that matters."

day5_good_yuna.name: Yuna
day5_good_yuna.text: "...I know you wavered. But you came to me in the end. ...That's enough."

day5_good_dain.name: Dain
day5_good_dain.text: "Psh~ I knew from the start! That you'd end up coming to me! ...I'm glad."

day5_good_nurse.name: Nurse
day5_good_nurse.text: "I knew you were popular. Hehe. But right now, in this moment— only look at me."

day5_good_teacher.name: Teacher
day5_good_teacher.text: "...Player. But if you came to me, that's enough. From now on, eyes on me only. Got it?"

day5_good_final.name: Me
day5_good_final.text: *The warmth of our clasped hands quietly covered over all the missteps and hesitation along the way.*

day5_mayhem_start.name: Me
day5_mayhem_start.text: *I came up to the rooftop and— wait, what?*

day5_mayhem_3.name: Seoyeon
day5_mayhem_3.text: "Oh, {name}! I was just about to come up to the rooftop too~"

day5_mayhem_5.name: Dain
day5_mayhem_5.text: "HEY!! I'm here too!! Wait, why is everyone here?!"

day5_mayhem_teacher_watch.name: Me
day5_mayhem_teacher_watch.text: *In the distance, the teacher is watching this unfold. Her expression is... complicated.*

day5_mayhem_nurse_watch.name: Me
day5_mayhem_nurse_watch.text: *The nurse is watching this situation through a window, too.*

day5_mayhem_6.name: Me
day5_mayhem_6.text: *This is... the opening act of a catastrophe.*

day5_mayhem_7.name: Seoyeon
day5_mayhem_7.text: "By the way, {name}, you remember our plans for this weekend, right?"

day5_mayhem_8.name: Yuna
day5_mayhem_8.text: "...What? You made plans with me too."

day5_mayhem_9.name: Dain
day5_mayhem_9.text: "Huh?! You told me you were free too!!"

day5_mayhem_10.name: Me
day5_mayhem_10.text: *Everyone's eyes lock onto me at the same time. ...I'm finished.*

day5_mayhem_honest.name: Me
day5_mayhem_honest.text: "A-actually, you're all such amazing people that I couldn't pick just one..."

day5_mayhem_run.name: Me
day5_mayhem_run.text: *I bolt for the rooftop door without looking back!!*

day5_mayhem_run_2.name: Seoyeon
day5_mayhem_run_2.text: "Wait, {name}!! Where do you think you're going?!"

day5_mayhem_run_4.name: Dain
day5_mayhem_run_4.text: "Hey, wait!! I'm the fastest runner in our class!! You can't escape!!"

day5_mayhem_run_5.name: Me
day5_mayhem_run_5.text: *I'm flying down the stairs and everyone's chasing me. Why is everyone so fast?!*

day5_mayhem_confess.name: Me
day5_mayhem_confess.text: "...I'm not joking. I sincerely like every single one of you."

day5_mayhem_confess_2.name: Me
day5_mayhem_confess_2.text: "It's not that I can't choose— I don't want to. Choosing one means losing the rest."

day5_mayhem_confess_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_mayhem_confess_seoyeon.text: "...Hah. You've got some nerve. You know you'd normally get slapped for that, right?"

day5_mayhem_confess_yuna.name: Yuna
day5_mayhem_confess_yuna.text: "...The worst. But I'll give you credit for being honest."

day5_mayhem_confess_dain.name: Dain
day5_mayhem_confess_dain.text: "HEY!! That doesn't even make sense!! ...But why don't I hate it?!"

day5_mayhem_confess_silence.name: Me
day5_mayhem_confess_silence.text: *They all look at each other. A strange silence.*

day5_mayhem_confess_seoyeon_2.name: Seoyeon
day5_mayhem_confess_seoyeon_2.text: "...I have one condition. You treat me the best."

day5_mayhem_confess_react.name: Me
day5_mayhem_confess_react.text: *...They all glare at me simultaneously. Those eyes are terrifying.*

day5_mayhem_confess_final.name: Me
day5_mayhem_confess_final.text: *This might be the beginning of hell. But right now— I'm the happiest man alive.*

day5_mayhem_final.name: Me
day5_mayhem_final.text: *The sunset fades. Is this really how a peaceful Sunday afternoon ends?*

day5_mayhem_final_2.name: Me
day5_mayhem_final_2.text: *...But somehow I don't feel bad about it. This chaotic life— it's its own kind of happiness.*

day5_friend_start.name: Me
day5_friend_start.text: *The sunset paints the rooftop. I look at the person beside me.*

day5_friend_choice.name: Me
day5_friend_choice.text: *This is my last chance to say how I feel. What should I do?*

day5_friend_confess.name: Me
day5_friend_confess.text: "The truth is, I like you. I've been trying to say it since yesterday, and I finally found the courage."

day5_late_accept_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_late_accept_seoyeon.text: "...Dummy. I've been waiting this whole time. I like you too."

day5_late_accept_yuna.name: Yuna
day5_late_accept_yuna.text: "...You're late. Really, really late. But it's okay. I feel the same."

day5_late_accept_dain.name: Dain
day5_late_accept_dain.text: "...!! FINALLY!! Do you know how long I've been waiting since yesterday?! I like you too, dummy!!"

day5_late_accept_nurse.name: Nurse
day5_late_accept_nurse.text: "...You're finally saying it? I feel the same way. Have for a long time."

day5_late_accept_teacher.name: Teacher
day5_late_accept_teacher.text: "...Hah, you should've said so yesterday. I was up all night over this. I like you too, dummy."

day5_late_accept_transition1.name: Me
day5_late_accept_transition1.text: *We stared at each other for a long moment, then burst out laughing.*

day5_late_accept_transition2.name: Me
day5_late_accept_transition2.text: *Something so simple. Why did it take this long?*

day5_friend_stay.name: Me
day5_friend_stay.text: "...I'm really glad I met someone like you at this school."

day5_friend_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day5_friend_seoyeon.text: "...Hm. Well, I knew already. You were a variable I didn't plan for. ...Next time, I'll be the one to take the lead."

day5_friend_yuna.name: Yuna
day5_friend_yuna.text: "...Yeah. ...It was fun. See you in the next story."

day5_friend_dain.name: Dain
day5_friend_dain.text: "Tch, that's a bummer! But it's your choice. Next time you'd better give me a shot!"

day5_friend_nurse.name: Nurse
day5_friend_nurse.text: "...Right. You're a good student. ...A good student."

day5_friend_teacher.name: Teacher
day5_friend_teacher.text: "...Yeah, well. Teacher and student, so that's only natural. ...Only natural."

day5_friend_bitter.name: Me
day5_friend_bitter.text: *Their smile looked a little wistful. A corner of my heart ached, too.*

day5_friend_final.name: Me
day5_friend_final.text: *Was this the right choice? I don't know. But this, too, is an ending.*

day5_alone_start.name: Me
day5_alone_start.text: *Watching the sunset alone on the rooftop. My time at this school flashes past like a montage.*

day5_alone_2.name: Me
day5_alone_2.text: *Seoyeon, Yuna, Dain, the teachers. So many good people.*

day5_alone_3.name: Me
day5_alone_3.text: *Should I have told one of them how I felt? Probably.*

day5_alone_4.name: Me
day5_alone_4.text: *But I don't regret it. The time I spent here is precious on its own.*

day5_alone_5.name: Me
day5_alone_5.text: *I'm alone, but not lonely. I've definitely changed from who I was before the transfer.*

day5_alone_6.name: Me
day5_alone_6.text: *Tomorrow is a fresh start. This time, I'll be a little braver.*
